from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
def cls(p):
    r,g,b=p
    if abs(r-240)<18 and abs(g-217)<18 and abs(b-181)<18: return ' '
    if abs(r-181)<18 and abs(g-136)<18 and abs(b-99)<18: return ' '
    if r+g+b < 250: return '#'
    if r+g+b > 600: return 'O'
    return '+'
squares=[(r,f) for r in range(8) for f in range(8)]
# only occupied
for r,f in squares:
    x0=f*80; y0=r*80
    # determine occupied by non-bg
    arr=[[cls(im.getpixel((x0+x,y0+y))) for x in range(80)] for y in range(80)]
    n=sum(ch!=' ' for row in arr for ch in row)
    if n<20: continue
    print(f"--- {chr(97+f)}{8-r}  (r{r}f{f}) n={n} ---")
    # downsample 2x2 to 40x40, prefer ink
    for y in range(0,80,2):
        line=''
        for x in range(0,80,2):
            chs=[arr[y][x],arr[y][x+1],arr[y+1][x],arr[y+1][x+1]]
            # prefer # then O then + then space
            for want in '#O+':
                if want in chs: line+=want; break
            else: line+=' '
        print(line.rstrip())
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageFont, ImageDraw
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
a=np.array(im).astype(int)
def bgcolor(f,r):
    return np.array([240,217,181]) if (f+r)%2==0 else np.array([181,136,99])
names={0x2654:'WK',0x2655:'WQ',0x2656:'WR',0x2657:'WB',0x2658:'WN',0x2659:'WP',
       0x265a:'BK',0x265b:'BQ',0x265c:'BR',0x265d:'BB',0x265e:'BN',0x265f:'BP'}
fontpath='/fonts/noto.ttf'
def render(code):
    f=ImageFont.truetype(fontpath,100)
    ch=chr(code)
    im2=Image.new('L',(160,160),0)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im2)
    bbox=d.textbbox((0,0),ch,font=f)
    w=bbox[2]-bbox[0]; h=bbox[3]-bbox[1]
    d.text(((160-w)/2-bbox[0],(160-h)/2-bbox[1]),ch,font=f,fill=255)
    arr=np.array(im2)>128
    ys,xs=np.where(arr)
    crop=arr[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1]
    return np.array(Image.fromarray((crop*255).astype(np.uint8)).resize((64,64),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))>128
templates={code:render(code) for code in names}
def largest(mask):
    h,w=mask.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(mask,bool); best=[]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if mask[y,x] and not seen[y,x]:
                q=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=1; comp=[]
                while q:
                    cy,cx=q.pop(); comp.append((cy,cx))
                    for dy in (-1,0,1):
                        for dx in (-1,0,1):
                            if dy==dx==0: continue
                            ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and mask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]:
                                seen[ny,nx]=1; q.append((ny,nx))
                if len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
    out=np.zeros_like(mask,bool)
    for y,x in best: out[y,x]=1
    return out
for r in range(8):
    for f in range(8):
        sq=a[r*80:(r+1)*80, f*80:(f+1)*80]
        bg=bgcolor(f,r)
        dist=np.abs(sq-bg).max(axis=2)
        ink=dist>40
        bright=sq.sum(axis=2)
        black=ink & (bright<350)
        white=ink & (bright>600)
        cb=largest(black) if black.any() else np.zeros((80,80),bool)
        cw=largest(white) if white.any() else np.zeros((80,80),bool)
        if max(cb.sum(),cw.sum())<100: continue
        color='B' if cb.sum()>=cw.sum() else 'W'
        mask=cb if color=='B' else cw
        ys,xs=np.where(mask)
        crop=mask[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]
        crop=np.array(Image.fromarray((crop*255).astype(np.uint8)).resize((64,64),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))>128
        scores=[]
        for code,nm in names.items():
            if not nm.startswith(color): continue
            t=templates[code]
            iou=(crop&t).sum()/(crop|t).sum()
            scores.append((iou,nm))
        scores.sort(reverse=True)
        print(f"{chr(97+f)}{8-r}: {color} size={mask.sum():4d} best={scores[0][1]} iou={scores[0][0]:.3f} 2nd={scores[1][1]} {scores[1][0]:.3f}")
PY
